thread:
Samir: Quick follow-up from the outage postmortem — need to finalize customer-facing language and lock the action-item tracker before publishing.

Ava: +1. Do we have a canonical status-page blurb?

Samir: Draft below. Non-technical, transparent. Legal/PSs review required.

Samir: DRAFT STATUS BLURB:
We experienced degraded API availability for the Redwood hosted inference service between 02:14 and 02:42 UTC. The root cause was an autoscaling configuration change that exhausted reserved GPU capacity for a small set of models. Service was restored after a controlled capacity increase and rollback of the misconfiguration. No customer data was exposed. A final post-incident report (RCA) will be published to our status page and shared with affected customers within 5 business days.

Marcus: Good. Can we add explicit "no data exposed" once Priya confirms?

Priya: Confirmed — no data exposure. Also suggest line about how customers can request the RCA.

Leah: Suggest: "A final post-incident report (RCA) will be published to our status page and shared with affected customers within 5 business days."

Jon: Add mitigation in plain language: increased capacity + rollback.

Samir: Updated draft with Leah/Jon edits. Any objections?

Samir: UPDATED DRAFT:
We experienced degraded API availability for the Redwood hosted inference service between 02:14 and 02:42 UTC. The issue was caused by a recent autoscaling configuration change that exhausted reserved GPU capacity for a small set of models. Service was restored after a controlled capacity increase and rollback of the misconfiguration. No customer data was exposed. A final post-incident report (RCA) will be published to our status page and shared with affected customers within 5 business days.

Ava: Looks good; I'll stage on the status page once Priya signs off.

Marcus: For enterprise customers, recommend a slightly more technical 1-paragraph + 4-bullet email with timeline, per-region impact, mitigation, and next steps. I'll draft.

Samir: Postmortem flagged a recurring pattern: autoscale policy changes combined with low-canary traffic creating unexpected config states. Propose tagging this postmortem as "recurring-pattern" and creating a product epic to harden policy-change workflows.

Leah: No objections. Suggest measurable goal: reduce config-related outages by 80% in 6 months.

Marcus: Agree. Also recommend weekly audit dashboard for autoscale policy changes.

Priya: Customer RCAs should be redacted for sensitive logs. ACTION-7: Redacted customer-RCA workflow — Owner: Priya — Due: 2026-03-29.

incident-bot: Follow-up checklist created: https://redwood.internal/incident/INC-2026-113/followups (automated)
